svg.aria-label: Send latency over 90 real-network sends per build on 2026-09-19. Baseline: mean 1,744.136 ms, median 1,219.175 ms, p95 5,842.597 ms, p99 10,630.380 ms. Reusing connected sockets: mean 145.304 ms, median 144.840 ms, p95 150.721 ms, p99 155.624 ms. The mean fell 91.7%, and the reuse bars stay near 150 ms at every percentile.
